name: gizza-ai/eml-parse
summary: Parse a raw .eml / RFC 822 email message

tool.description: Parse a raw .eml / RFC 5322 email message into structured fields: subject, date, message-id, from/to/cc (name + address), the decoded plain-text and HTML bodies, and a list of attachments (filename, MIME content-type, size in bytes). MIME multipart messages and encoded headers/bodies are decoded automatically. Runs locally.

eml.description: The raw .eml / RFC 822 message text (headers plus body, including MIME parts).
